NORTH CAROLINA
DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE RALEIGH, N. C. 27611
April 24, 1972
Mr. Randolph Hendricks Clearinghouse and Information Center 116 West Jones Street Raleigh, North Carolina 27603
Re: Letter dated April 7, 1972 Concerning Draft Environmental Statement, Proposed Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972, U.S. Department of the Interior
Dear Mr. Hendricks:
The draft for the proposed Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972 was circulated to the Veterinary Division and the Museum of Natural History Division of the North Carolina Department of Agriculture for their comments. They both agreed that this type of legislature is needed and are willing to cooperate in anyway that they can.
If I can be of further assistance, please advise.
Cordially,
Alex M. Lewis Controller
